notes: Service core redesigned: ALL units flush at south Y=6 and north Y=174 (14'-6").

Staircase: 4' landing at south wall, 2 flights of 12 treads×9"=9'-0" each, 4' void at north.

Assembly Hall starts at Y=180 (15'-0") — full 55'-0" clear width × 60'-0" length.
Wall thickness: 12" outer perimeter, 6" internal partitions.
First-floor D-FF-08 through D-FF-10 are modeled on the north wall to connect the lower rooms to the stack area; verify this intent against the source drawing before construction.
